checkable.sympy: g, b = symbols('g b', integer=True, nonnegative=True); n = 2*g + b; Eq((n - 1).subs({g: 0, b: 2}), 1)
checkable.asserts: In modern terms, the connectivity order of a compact orientable surface of genus g with b>0 boundary curves is n = 2g + b. It needs n−1 cross-cuts to become simply connected. An annulus (g=0, b=2) needs one cut. This is Riemann's published result, not something read off this page.
